summary: Flag Ship Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting shareholder approval to extend the deadline to complete an initial business combination up to twelve one-month periods from June 20, 2026 to June 20, 2027. The extension is contingent on the sponsor depositing the lesser of $60,000 or $0.033 per outstanding public share per month into the trust. The filing also notes entry into a trust amendment with Wilmington Trust. No business combination is announced; this is a procedural extension to maintain SPAC status. There are no deal terms or risk-arb angle as no transaction is identified.
